instruction: Using the images pic3.png through pic6.png saved on the Desktop, create a presentation with four blank slides. Insert the images sequentially: pic3.png on the first slide, pic4.png on the second, pic5.png on the third, and pic6.png on the fourth. Make sure each slide contains only the image without text boxes or other elements.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating 4 blank slides and inserting pic3.png through pic6.png sequentially. Expected: 4 slides total, each with exactly 1 image. Uses a different subset of images starting from pic3.

llm_judge_reasons: Incomplete verification coverage: Instruction requires 'each slide contains only the image without text boxes or other elements', but evaluator only counts images without verifying absence of other elements
Getter logic only checks shape.shape_type == 13 (pictures) but does not verify that other shape types (text boxes, shapes, etc.) are absent from slides
Missing verification: Does not check which specific images (pic3.png vs pic4.png vs pic5.png vs pic6.png) are on which slides - only counts that 1 image exists per slide
A slide with 1 image + multiple text boxes would incorrectly pass evaluation (images_per_slide=[1] matches expected, but text boxes are present)
Expected values are semantically incomplete: only specifies image counts, not the full requirement of 'only images, no other elements'
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Enhance getter to count ALL shape types per slide (not just images), return dict like {'slide_count': int, 'images_per_slide': [counts], 'total_shapes_per_slide': [counts]}
Update metric to verify that total_shapes_per_slide equals images_per_slide (ensuring no non-image shapes exist)
Optional: Add image name/hash verification to confirm pic3.png is on slide 1, pic4.png on slide 2, etc., by extracting image metadata from PPTX
Update expected values to include 'total_shapes_per_slide': [1, 1, 1, 1] to enforce 'only image' constraint
